# Acceptance

**AC1 — When a stage stops short, the directory it leaves says so.**
Falsifier: a directory left by a legitimate stop a reader cannot tell from an interrupted run.

**AC2: When a deliverable is missing, the message names it.**
Falsifier: a message reporting only that something is wrong.

**AC3 - When a deliverable exists, every signed criterion is accounted for in it.**
Falsifier: a criterion the human signed that the deliverable never mentions.
